articles.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
articles.snippet: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.snippet: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

articles.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
articles.snippet: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

articles.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
articles.snippet: The banks tested a new way to trade fractions of physical gold bars and use the metal as collateral without moving it from vaults for the first time.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.
